why_synthetic: test-materials has 34 JPEGs and none exceed MAX_DETECT_PIXELS; AC4 required one PNG and one JPEG
proves: the rejection path is format-independent (JPEG behaves like PNG)
does_not_prove: detection quality on real oversized manga pages

samples.message: core.detect page is too large to process safely: 5000x4000 = 20000000 px exceeds the 11184810 px limit (1.79x over). The page was rejected before any pixel decoding, so no page-sized buffer was allocated. Reduce the page to at most 11184810 pixels (about 3344x3344) and retry, or split a tall page into several shorter images.
